sentences.en: Acute inflammation of various types, suppuration, granulation-tissue formation, &c., represent some of the complex resulting processes.

sentences.en: Thus Krawkow and Nowak, employing the frequent subcutaneous injection of the usual organisms of suppuration, have induced in the fowl the deposition within the tissues of a homogeneous substance giving the colour reactions of true amyloid.

sentences.en: Within a few days recovery usually occurs somewhat suddenly, but death may occur from the severe depression, or from the secondary effects of suppuration.

sentences.en: But when the hepatitis is of septic origin, suppuration is likely to occur, the result being an hepatic abscess.

sentences.en: A number of interesting experiments, designed to test the relationship between the condition of suppuration and the production of amyloid, have been made of late years.

sentences.en: Nowak, however, found later that he could generate it where the turpentine failed to induce suppuration; he believes that it may arise quite apart from the influence of the organisms of suppuration, that it is not a biological product of the micro-organisms of disease, and also that it has nothing to do with emaciation.
sentences.vi: Nowak, tuy nhiên, sau đó phát hiện ra rằng anh ta có thể tạo ra nó khi nhựa thông không tạo ra được sự bão hòa; ông tin rằng nó có thể phát sinh hoàn toàn ngoài ảnh hưởng của các sinh vật tiêu diệt, rằng nó không phải là sản phẩm sinh học của các vi sinh vật gây bệnh, và nó cũng không liên quan gì đến sự gầy mòn.

sentences.en: Thus the organisms of suppuration, tubercle, glanders, diphtheria, typhoid fever, cholera, tetanus, and others were identified, and their relationship to the individual diseases established.
